Scott's Tuesday Night Mountain Bike Ride

Cleveland, TN · Mountain bike

Beginner friendlyWomen / trans / femme

Scott's Tuesday Night Mountain Bike Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Cleveland, TN. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Enterprise South Nature Park main lot (Chattanooga); beginners at Johnston Woods trailhead (Cleveland). Pace: advanced, intermediate, beginner and women's groups.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: advanced, intermediate, beginner and women's groups. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Scott's Tuesday Night Mountain Bike Ride group ride

A weekly mountain bike ride split by skill. Advanced, intermediate and women's groups meet at Enterprise South Nature Park, and the Velo Vixens ride along. Beginners ride Johnston Woods in Cleveland. From September 29, 2026 the main group moves to White Oak trailhead in Collegedale. No riding on wet trails. The group goes out to eat after the ride on the second Tuesday.
